headline: Maple Bacon Brussels Sprouts Will Turn the Biggest Skeptic Into a Fan
description: This maple bacon Brussels sprouts recipe combines crispy roasted sprouts, smoky bacon, sweet maple syrup, and tangy mustard for an irresistible side dish.
name: Maple Bacon Brussels Sprouts Will Turn the Biggest Skeptic Into a Fan
recipeIngredient: 1 1/2 pounds fresh brussels sprouts, trimmed and halved (or quartered if large)
5 slices (about 5 ounces) bacon, cut crosswise into 1/2-inch-thick pieces

recipeInstructions.name: Preheat the oven to 400°F.
recipeInstructions.text: Line a large rimmed baking sheet with aluminum foil.

recipeInstructions.name: Combine the ingredients:
recipeInstructions.text: On the prepared baking sheet, stir together the brussels sprouts, oil, maple syrup, mustard, salt, paprika, and pepper until well combined. Spread into a single layer. Sprinkle the bacon evenly around the brussels sprouts mixture, separating any pieces that stick together.

recipeInstructions.name: Roast:
recipeInstructions.text: Bake until the bacon is rendered and the brussels sprouts are browned and tender, 30 to 35 minutes, stirring every 10 minutes. Stir in the thyme leaves, if using, and serve immediately. Refrigerate leftovers in an airtight container for up to 4 days.

mainEntityOfPage.name: Maple Bacon Brussels Sprouts Will Turn the Biggest Skeptic Into a Fan
